segments.text: Before using X-Tool Metal Fab Laser Welder, please carefully watch this video and read the safety instructions for the product.
segments.zh: 在使用 xTool MetalFab 激光焊机之前，请仔细观看本视频，并阅读产品的安全说明。

segments.text: Strictly follow all the safety instructions and regulations. Safety is our top priority.
segments.zh: 严格遵守所有安全说明和规定。安全是我们的首要任务。

segments.text: Always ensure you are wearing the proper protective equipment, such as laser safety goggles that protect your eyes from laser beams at the wavelength of around 1080 nanometers.
segments.zh: 始终确保你穿戴了合适的防护装备，比如能防护波长约 1080 纳米激光束、保护眼睛的激光防护眼镜。

segments.text: Always use the product in a laser-controlled area with laser safety barriers.
segments.zh: 始终在设有激光安全屏障的激光管控区域内使用本产品。

segments.text: Ensure that everyone entering the laser-controlled area has been trained in laser safety and warn all the necessary personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 确保进入激光管控区域的每个人都接受过激光安全培训，并穿戴所有必要的个人防护装备。

segments.text: 1. How a laser beam travels
segments.zh: 1. 激光束如何传播

segments.text: Now, let's begin with understanding how a laser beam travels.
segments.zh: 现在，我们先来了解激光束是如何传播的。

segments.text: The welding head emits two types of laser beams.
segments.zh: 焊接头会发出两种激光束。

segments.text: One is a visible red beam used for positioning, and the other is an invisible high-power infrared beam used for processing.
segments.zh: 一种是用于定位的可见红光，另一种是用于加工的不可见高功率红外光束。

segments.text: The infrared laser beam will diverge from the focal point and create a cone of radiation.
segments.zh: 红外激光束会从焦点处发散开来，形成一个辐射锥。

segments.text: As the beam moves away from the focal point, its power density decreases.
segments.zh: 光束离焦点越远，其功率密度就越低。

segments.text: Even though the laser power is weakened as the beam gets farther from the welding head, it can still be high enough to cause harm to skin and eyes.
segments.zh: 虽然光束离焊接头越远，激光功率就越弱，但仍然可能高到足以伤害皮肤和眼睛。

segments.text: Keep people away from the laser reflection zone. Never look into the laser outlet.
segments.zh: 让人员远离激光反射区。绝不要直视激光出光口。

segments.text: 2. Important safety measures
segments.zh: 2. 重要的安全措施

segments.text: Everyone inside the laser-controlled area should wear the following protective equipment.
segments.zh: 激光管控区域内的每个人都应穿戴以下防护装备。

segments.text: Laser safety goggles or face shield certified to protect against laser radiation of around 1080 nanometers with an optical density greater than 6.
segments.zh: 经认证可防护约 1080 纳米激光辐射、光密度大于 6 的激光防护眼镜或面罩。

segments.text: Laser and heat-resistant clothing and gloves and a dust mask.
segments.zh: 防激光和耐热的服装与手套，以及防尘口罩。

segments.text: Never look directly into the laser outlet or point the outlet at any body part.
segments.zh: 绝不要直视激光出光口，也不要把出光口对准身体的任何部位。

segments.text: Ensure that a fire extinguisher and other safety equipment are available in the laser processing area.
segments.zh: 确保激光加工区域配有灭火器和其他安全设备。

segments.text: Do not place flammable or combustible materials in the laser processing area.
segments.zh: 不要在激光加工区域放置易燃或可燃材料。

segments.text: Never process containers with flammable or combustible materials.
segments.zh: 绝不要加工装有易燃或可燃材料的容器。

segments.text: 3. Key components and controls of the welder
segments.zh: 3. 焊机的关键部件和控制装置

segments.text: Now, let's walk through the key components and controls of the laser welder.
segments.zh: 现在，我们来逐一了解激光焊机的关键部件和控制装置。

segments.text: Emergency stop button. In case of any exception, press the button to immediately shut off the machine.
segments.zh: 急停按钮。遇到任何异常情况，按下这个按钮可以立即关停机器。

segments.text: To restart the machine, rotate and pull out the button.
segments.zh: 要重新启动机器，旋转并拔出这个按钮。

segments.text: USB key, insert the USB key to enable the laser processing function.
segments.zh: USB 钥匙，插入 USB 钥匙即可启用激光加工功能。

segments.text: The USB key can also be used to establish an interlocked entrance.
segments.zh: USB 钥匙还可以用来设置联锁门禁。

segments.text: For more details, refer to the tutorials on supportxtool.com.
segments.zh: 更多详情，请参阅 support.xtool.com 上的教程。

segments.text: Shielding gas supply.
segments.zh: 保护气供应。

segments.text: Laser processing uses shielding gas.
segments.zh: 激光加工需要使用保护气。

segments.text: Keep the gas cylinders away from the processing area and out of the path of any laser reflections.
segments.zh: 让气瓶远离加工区域，并避开任何激光反射的路径。

segments.text: Workpiece sensing cable. Connect the workpiece sensing cable to port 4.
segments.zh: 工件感应线。把工件感应线连接到 4 号接口。

segments.text: Then, clamp its other end to the workpiece or the conductive work table.
segments.zh: 然后，把它的另一端夹在工件或导电工作台上。

segments.text: Do not clamp it to the welding head.
segments.zh: 不要把它夹在焊接头上。

segments.text: 4. Welding operations. On the touchscreen, activate both the enable lasering and enable wire feeding functions.
segments.zh: 4. 焊接操作。在触摸屏上，同时激活“启用激光”和“启用送丝”功能。

segments.text: Ensure the welding head is in contact with the workpiece.
segments.zh: 确保焊接头与工件接触。

segments.text: Press the grip sensing button and the welding head indicator will flash green,
segments.zh: 按下握持感应按钮，焊接头指示灯会闪烁绿光，

segments.text: indicating the machine is ready to emit laser.
segments.zh: 表示机器已准备好出光。

segments.text: Press the firing trigger to start laser welding.
segments.zh: 按下出光扳机开始激光焊接。

segments.text: During laser welding, do not hold the workpieces in your hand or place your hand under the workpieces,
segments.zh: 激光焊接时，不要用手拿着工件，也不要把手放在工件下面，

segments.text: as the heat generated by welding can burn the skin.
segments.zh: 因为焊接产生的热量会烫伤皮肤。

segments.text: Laser beams can reflect from multiple surfaces.
segments.zh: 激光束可能会在多个表面上反射。

segments.text: Diffuse reflection from rough surfaces can spread over a large area.
segments.zh: 粗糙表面的漫反射会扩散到很大的范围。

segments.text: Always stay alert to the danger of laser radiation during welding.
segments.zh: 焊接过程中要时刻警惕激光辐射的危险。

segments.text: Only observe the weld pool from behind the welding head.
segments.zh: 只能从焊接头后方观察熔池。

segments.text: Do not choose any other position for observation.
segments.zh: 不要选择其他任何位置进行观察。

segments.text: If anyone stands in the laser reflection zone, stop laser emission immediately.
segments.zh: 如果有人站在激光反射区内，要立即停止出光。

segments.text: If the metal fails to melt completely, the laser beam may diffuse from the welding spot.
segments.zh: 如果金属没有完全熔化，激光束可能会从焊点处漫射出去。

segments.text: Stop processing immediately to avoid laser hazards.
segments.zh: 要立即停止加工，以避免激光危害。

segments.text: Always remain vigilant during laser processing.
segments.zh: 激光加工过程中要始终保持警惕。

segments.text: If you find any potential risks, stop laser emission immediately.
segments.zh: 如果发现任何潜在风险，要立即停止出光。

segments.text: The smoke generated during welding may contain toxic particles.
segments.zh: 焊接时产生的烟雾可能含有有毒颗粒物。

segments.text: It is recommended to use an exhaust system to remove the smoke.
segments.zh: 建议使用排风系统排出烟雾。

segments.text: Operators must also wear necessary respiratory protective equipment.
segments.zh: 操作人员还必须佩戴必要的呼吸防护装备。

segments.text: 5. Stop processing.
segments.zh: 5. 停止加工。

segments.text: To pause the machine, deactivate the enable wire feeding and enable lasering functions.
segments.zh: 要暂停机器，就关闭“启用送丝”和“启用激光”功能。

segments.text: If you have finished processing, turn off the machine's power and gas supply.
segments.zh: 如果加工已经完成，关闭机器的电源和供气。

segments.text: Following these steps and adhering to the safety instructions can help promote a smooth and safe welding experience.
segments.zh: 按照这些步骤并遵守安全说明，有助于实现顺利、安全的焊接体验。

segments.text: Thank you for watching.
segments.zh: 感谢观看。
